items.source: Such wrappers will automatically be unwrapped for key comparisons in TransactionSynchronizationManager.
items.translation: 此类包装器将在对 `TransactionSynchronizationManager` 进行键比较时自动解包。

items.source: Only fully transparent proxies, for example, for redirection or service lookups, are supposed to implement this interface. Proxies that decorate the target object with new behavior, such as AOP proxies, do not qualify here!
items.translation: 只有完全透明的代理（例如用于重定向或服务查找的代理）才应实现此接口。像 AOP 代理那样为目标对象添加新行为的代理，不符合此处要求！
返回底层资源（永远不为null）。
